title: Observation, assessment and authority boundaries
summary: ML outputs are evidence objects, not automatic truth or operational authority. Observation, feature, inference, assessment, claim and action remain separate.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: An anomaly is not an identity or wrongdoing claim.
A probability or fitness value is not a fact.
Operational action belongs to policy/authority outside the model.
procedure: Require domain policy to convert an advisory assessment into action.

provenance.claim: Camera behavioural evidence avoids identity/authority overclaiming.
